senses.gloss:
HE:
I Pron.:
(1) तद् (= that),
I am he:
एषोऽस्मि
 सः, Mu. vii. 4.;
here is he:
अयं सः, Sa.;

also:
सोऽपि, D.;
(2) अदस्, which of them is he:
कतमोऽसौ, D.; what he would have done to you:
त्वय्यसौ यदकरिष्यत्, K.
(3) इदम् (= this),
is he a
new-comer:
किमयमागन्तुकः, Mu.;
(4) एतद्,
(= this: q.v.);
(5) not expr. when the
meaning is clear,
moreover he is cruel:
अपरञ्च
 क्रूरः, P. Ph.:
things he is a Śudra:
शूद्रोऽहमिति
 मन्यते, G. p.: v. That.
II He who, he
that: यद्॥॥तद्: v. Who.
III A male:
q.v.: expr. by m. gender:
he-goat:
छागः।
